facts.text: The planet was initially discovered almost 7,000 years before the Battle of Yavin, and possession of the planet became heavily contested after its discovery.

evidence.quote: An InterGalactic Banking Clan stronghold, it was aligned with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

facts.text: It was the site of the Third Battle of Mygeeto, and the Galactic Republic assaulted Mygeeto during the Outer Rim Sieges.

evidence.quote: It was the site of the Third Battle of Mygeeto, and the Galactic Republic assaulted Mygeeto during the Outer Rim Sieges.

facts.text: Mygeeto was a wealthy InterGalactic Banking Clan colony between Ord Biniir and Morishim under the control of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

evidence.quote: Mygeeto was a wealthy InterGalactic Banking Clan colony between Ord Biniir and Morishim under the control of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

facts.text: Since Mygeeto was locked in an ice age, giant crystallized glaciation and ice covered its surface, as well as huge crystal spurs.

evidence.quote: Since Mygeeto was locked in an ice age, giant crystallized glaciation and ice covered its surface, as well as huge crystal spurs.

facts.text: The planet's ice shelves were home to a species of huge and aggressive worm-like creatures.

evidence.quote: The planet's ice shelves were home to a species of huge and aggressive worm-like creatures.

facts.text: Mygeeto was not composed of a uniform terrain; instead it was composed of many different kinds of terrain.

evidence.quote: Mygeeto was not composed of a uniform terrain; instead it was composed of many different kinds of terrain.

facts.text: There was no reported volcanic activity on the planet, meaning that the planet's interior was stable.

evidence.quote: There was no reported volcanic activity on the planet, meaning that the planet's interior was stable.

facts.text: The immense amount of precious metals found in the crust supports the theory that Mygeeto's volcanic activities had been dormant for some time.

evidence.quote: The immense amount of precious metals found in the crust supports the theory that Mygeeto's volcanic activities had been dormant for some time.

facts.text: Few cities existed on Mygeeto's sunken surface.

evidence.quote: Few cities existed on Mygeeto's sunken surface.

facts.text: These cities drew power from synthesized crystals which were constructed in large capacitor towers that stored and distributed the valuable energy drawn from the crystal.

evidence.quote: These cities drew power from synthesized crystals which were constructed in large capacitor towers that stored and distributed the valuable energy drawn from the crystal.

facts.text: These cities were used mainly for administering the surrounding crystal mines, though they also contained vaults which were used by the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

evidence.quote: These cities were used mainly for administering the surrounding crystal mines, though they also contained vaults which were used by the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

facts.text: Nearly all of the planet's surface was covered in thick ice, and the polar climate caused massive snow storms that battered the frigid surface almost continuously.

evidence.quote: Nearly all of the planet's surface was covered in thick ice, and the polar climate caused massive snow storms that battered the frigid surface almost continuously.

facts.text: Before the giant ice age, Mygeeto had a climate ranging form polar to temperate—30% of Mygeeto was covered in polar ice caps and 70 was either tundra or temperate.

evidence.quote: Before the giant ice age, Mygeeto had a climate ranging form polar to temperate—30% of Mygeeto was covered in polar ice caps and 70 was either tundra or temperate.

facts.text: Every 200 years or so, Mygeeto would go through a snow shift meaning snowfall would be persistent and low pressure would dominate the northern hemisphere.

evidence.quote: Every 200 years or so, Mygeeto would go through a snow shift meaning snowfall would be persistent and low pressure would dominate the northern hemisphere.

facts.text: The sentient lemur-like Lurmens were indigenous to Mygeeto in times long forgotten during the Pre-Republic era.

evidence.quote: The sentient lemur-like Lurmens were indigenous to Mygeeto in times long forgotten during the Pre-Republic era.

facts.text: Around 30,000 BBY, an alien species known as the Rakata annexed Mygeeto as part of their Infinite Empire.

evidence.quote: Around 30,000 BBY, an alien species known as the Rakata annexed Mygeeto as part of their Infinite Empire.

facts.text: The Lurmen were forced by the Rakata to shape Mygeeto's crystal formations, but with the break-up of their empire after five thousand years of galactic dominance the Rakata abandoned Mygeeto and retreated to their homeworld of Lehon.

evidence.quote: The Lurmen were forced by the Rakata to shape Mygeeto's crystal formations, but with the break-up of their empire after five thousand years of galactic dominance the Rakata abandoned Mygeeto and retreated to their homeworld of Lehon.

facts.text: In 6740 BBY, the planet was rediscovered by smugglers, with Hutts and then Neimoidians taking control of the planet in the following years.

evidence.quote: In 6740 BBY, the planet was rediscovered by smugglers, with Hutts and then Neimoidians taking control of the planet in the following years.

facts.text: When the Muun-controlled InterGalactic Banking Clan discovered Mygeeto, the native Lurmens were reduced to a status little better than slaves.

evidence.quote: When the Muun-controlled InterGalactic Banking Clan discovered Mygeeto, the native Lurmens were reduced to a status little better than slaves.

facts.text: Even if intruders had bypassed the blockade, they were faced with the harsh, frozen surface of the planet itself.

evidence.quote: Even if intruders had bypassed the blockade, they were faced with the harsh, frozen surface of the planet itself.

facts.text: The Banking Clan also constructed several cities on Mygeeto.

evidence.quote: The Banking Clan also constructed several cities on Mygeeto.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, Mygeeto became a valuable member of the Confederacy of Independent Systems and was as a result named by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine as part of a "Triad of Evil," alongside Felucia and Saleucami.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, Mygeeto became a valuable member of the Confederacy of Independent Systems and was as a result named by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine as part of a "Triad of Evil," alongside Felucia and Saleucami.

facts.text: Later, General Ki-Adi-Mundi led the Republic assault on the world along with Commander Bacara and the elite Galactic Marines.

evidence.quote: Later, General Ki-Adi-Mundi led the Republic assault on the world along with Commander Bacara and the elite Galactic Marines.

facts.text: By the conclusion of the battle in 19 BBY, the vast cityscape lay in burning, ash-filled ruins.

evidence.quote: By the conclusion of the battle in 19 BBY, the vast cityscape lay in burning, ash-filled ruins.

facts.text: The hot ashes mixed with Mygeeto's ice crystals to cover the battlegrounds in sleet and snow.

evidence.quote: The hot ashes mixed with Mygeeto's ice crystals to cover the battlegrounds in sleet and snow.

facts.text: Many Republic vehicles, including UT-ATs, were blown apart by Confederate tri-droids.

evidence.quote: Many Republic vehicles, including UT-ATs, were blown apart by Confederate tri-droids.

facts.text: After landing, Ki-Adi-Mundi led an assault on the energy collector, securing the power source that Palpatine had been looking for.

evidence.quote: After landing, Ki-Adi-Mundi led an assault on the energy collector, securing the power source that Palpatine had been looking for.

facts.text: Finally, he sent the power source offplanet to Coruscant, and aided the Republic troops in battle.

evidence.quote: Finally, he sent the power source offplanet to Coruscant, and aided the Republic troops in battle.

facts.text: Towards the end of the conflict, Commander Bacara received Order 66 and killed the Jedi General.

evidence.quote: Towards the end of the conflict, Commander Bacara received Order 66 and killed the Jedi General.

facts.text: Following the assassination, the remaining pockets of droids were eliminated, thus ending the two year-long battle and the Confederacy's presence on Mygeeto.

evidence.quote: Following the assassination, the remaining pockets of droids were eliminated, thus ending the two year-long battle and the Confederacy's presence on Mygeeto.

facts.text: After Mundi's death and the resolution of the Clone Wars, the newly established Galactic Empire enslaved the planet, claiming it on behalf of Palpatine, who had now taken on the title of Emperor.

evidence.quote: After Mundi's death and the resolution of the Clone Wars, the newly established Galactic Empire enslaved the planet, claiming it on behalf of Palpatine, who had now taken on the title of Emperor.

facts.text: The Imperial war-machine would keep strict control in the turbulent times following the Clone Wars; they extensively strip-mined the planet for a mineral known as durasteel, used in the construction of starship hulls.

evidence.quote: The Imperial war-machine would keep strict control in the turbulent times following the Clone Wars; they extensively strip-mined the planet for a mineral known as durasteel, used in the construction of starship hulls.

facts.text: However, unlike other factions of the CIS, the Empire did not destroy the IGBC, which would have doomed the galaxy to a crippling recession, but rather subjugated the government.

evidence.quote: However, unlike other factions of the CIS, the Empire did not destroy the IGBC, which would have doomed the galaxy to a crippling recession, but rather subjugated the government.

facts.text: Brutal labor conditions led to mass deaths among the enslaved Muun population.

evidence.quote: Brutal labor conditions led to mass deaths among the enslaved Muun population.
